scope: Camera anchor hysteresis and cinematic status-title palette only. This is not an integrated release receipt or completion of LS-04.

source_checks.jitter_regression: Alternating 4.99/5.00 anchor distances over 100 polls produces no anchor reversal. Periodic repair reapplies the retained anchor; simultaneous movement and repair emit one pan.

native_sdk.display_scope: One observed window size, including window frame; launch arguments are not claimed to equal measured render resolution.

compile.evidence: Sapien compiled and saved the candidate. Local compiled-tag readback matches the recorded hash and counts.

stage_views.assertion: Each stage entry reported its expected sv_stage, open Armory and sv_view_current in the stage-specific 1000-wide range. All four assertions were visually inspected as true in both candidate capture passes.

real_movement.scope: Short routes in protected Armory, not a complete perimeter/occlusion audit.
real_movement.stages_2_to_4: Held D for two seconds in each arena; native assertion confirmed player displacement >0.5, a changed camera anchor, correct stage anchor range and open Armory.
real_movement.stage_1: Initial two-second D route failed the combined movement/anchor-change assertion. A four-second W route passed; current anchor 1021 versus starting 1000, distance from center 8.955961. The initial failure is retained, not counted as a pass.

checkpoint_restart.method: Stopped the QA launcher, verified native child exit, and launched --continue in a new process. Verified console readiness before final assertions. No console camera repair was applied.
checkpoint_restart.checks: Two before-save and five after-restart assertions visually read true: state, actors, stage-two camera with valid distance, paused clock/shots, then real key 1 resumed with increasing clock and shots.

status_palette.description: Cinematic help/points/rank notices use dark text with a pale shadow on bright terrain and shaded rocks. Four stage captures and a shaded stage-one movement view were inspected.
status_palette.scope: Palette adjustment only. CHUD skill descriptions retain their separate style; small text, terrain exposure and broader combat readability still need work.
status_palette.before_capture: baseline-desktop.png is a valid original production stage-one baseline; the attempted four-stage before batch is invalid.

qa_corrections: The first baseline stage batch did not reach the console; no stage assertions were observed. before-stage*.png is excluded from pass evidence.

The first Continue command batch and immediately following stage-one rerun also missed console readiness. Debug key bindings changed game_speed. Those artifacts were preserved as invalid-first-*.png. No passes were claimed. QA CURRENT remained the recorded generation; a fresh process restart from that unchanged checkpoint preceded the valid checks.
Successful input used a 35 ms key press and 30 ms per character. Opening the console after a process restart required checking the visible H3 prompt; a sent key alone was not proof of readiness.

production_restoration.action: Restored the backed-up scenario, HSC, UI strings and original launcher-restored init. Relaunched the existing production launcher with --continue. No candidate package or launcher promotion.
production_restoration.visual_check: Observed the original stage-one overhead view with the paused Armory and saved Needler Rate rank 1 after production Continue; no input was sent to the restored production session.

not_tested: Native measurement of anchor-boundary jitter frequency
save_compatibility: Two added globals and changed HSC/scenario alter the exact-build fingerprint. Existing production cores remain tied to the restored v0.4 baseline; no migration is claimed.
evidence_storage: Private native workspace qa-ls04 on Onyx-Linux. Source repository contains this record and hashes; owned tags, saves and gameplay media are not included.
